stem.text: Which compounds, on heating with an excess of concentrated sulfuric acid, produce **only one** product with molecular formula $\text{C}_7\text{H}_{10}$?

items.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with an OH group on one ring carbon and a CH2OH group on the ring carbon opposite it.
Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with an OH group on one ring carbon and a CH2OH group on an adjacent ring carbon.
Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with an OH group and a CH2OH group on two ring carbons that are one carbon apart.
